item: Flight controller: Pixhawk FMUv6C class (reference: Holybro Pixhawk 6C)
purpose: The tier. Real FC MCU executing real autopilot firmware, supported by BOTH ArduPilot and PX4 from the same board.
what_it_buys: That the frozen core reads telemetry from real sensors on real silicon; and whether redundant_imu goes live on hardware, which PX4 SIH could not answer.
what_it_does_not_buy: Nothing about a FAULT (E3), nothing about flight (E5), no timing claim that transfers to a companion computer.

purpose: Firmware and onboard logs, one spare.
what_it_buys: The FC's own log, which is the independent record against CSIA's.

item: USB data cable for the FC
purpose: The rig/GCS command link: arm, set parameters, request streams.
what_it_buys: The ability to run a trial at all.
what_it_does_not_buy: Nothing. It is the command path, deliberately NOT CSIA's path.

purpose: CSIA's PASSIVE link on TELEM2, with the receive wire deliberately unconnected.
what_it_buys: NO_COMMAND_PATH_REACHABLE as a PHYSICAL fact rather than a software promise.

purpose: TX, RX (left unconnected) and GND between FC and adapter.
what_it_buys: A repeatable wiring, so a trial is a trial and not a wiring variation.

purpose: gnss.position, gnss.velocity and mag.field_ut from a real receiver.
what_it_buys: The four GNSS-gated relations being LIVE before the fault -- without which E2 cannot say what a fault would remove. Needed even though E2 injects no fault.
what_it_does_not_buy: Nothing about a GNSS FAULT. That is E3.

item: Computer running Linux to host csia-shadow
purpose: Runs the frozen CSIA runtime against the FC's telemetry.
what_it_buys: The whole software side of E2.
what_it_does_not_buy: No deployment-class timing claim: an x86 desktop is not a companion computer.
reuse_existing: YES -- the user's existing OptiPlex. See E2_COMPANION_COMPUTE_DECISION.md

item: Bench power supply for the FC
purpose: Powers the FC if USB cannot supply enough for the board plus GNSS.
what_it_buys: Stable power, so a brownout is not mistaken for a telemetry defect.
reuse_existing: check whether USB suffices first; many FMUv6C boards run fine on USB without servo rail load

purpose: Would host CSIA on deployment-class hardware.
what_it_buys: A latency distribution on target-class compute.
what_it_does_not_buy: Nothing E2 asks. Deferred: see E2_COMPANION_COMPUTE_DECISION.md.

purpose: A human with a kill path who is not the experimenter.
what_it_does_not_buy: Money does not solve site or airspace clearance.
